tutorials.title: Movement
tutorials.text: Use WASD or Arrow Keys to move your character. Hold Shift to run.

tutorials.title: Interacting
tutorials.text: Press SPACE or ENTER to interact with NPCs, doors, and objects.

tutorials.title: Main Menu
tutorials.text: Press ESC or X to open the main menu. Access Items, Equipment, Status, and Save here.

tutorials.title: Battle Started!
tutorials.text: Combat uses Active Time Battle (ATB). Your ATB gauge fills over time - when full, you can take an action.

tutorials.title: Battle Commands
tutorials.text: ATTACK: Basic physical attack. MAGIC: Use spells (costs MP). ITEM: Use consumables. LIMIT: Special attack when gauge is full.

tutorials.title: Elemental Weaknesses
tutorials.text: Enemies have elemental weaknesses! Hitting a weakness deals more damage. The Scan ability reveals enemy info.

tutorials.title: The Foundations
tutorials.text: You've acquired a Foundation! These ancient relics are the key to saving the world. Collect all eight.

tutorials.title: Limit Break!
tutorials.text: Your Limit Gauge is full! Taking damage fills this gauge. When full, you can unleash a devastating Limit Break attack!

tutorials.title: Equipment
tutorials.text: Equip weapons, armor, and accessories to boost stats. Different characters can equip different types of gear.

tutorials.title: Magic System
tutorials.text: Magic costs MP. You can restore MP with Ethers or by resting at Inns. Black Magic deals damage, White Magic heals.

tutorials.title: Synchronize!
tutorials.text: SYNCHRONIZE is a powerful state that activates when you exploit enemy weaknesses. Party deals more damage while SYNCED!

tutorials.title: World Map
tutorials.text: The Overworld connects all locations. Visit towns to rest and shop, dungeons to find Foundations.

tutorials.title: Save Points
tutorials.text: Glow crystals are Save Points. You can also save from the menu on the world map or at Inns.

tutorials.title: Shopping
tutorials.text: Buy items, weapons, and armor at shops. Prices vary by location. Some shops unlock new stock as you progress.

tutorials.title: Party Management
tutorials.text: You have more than 3 characters! Use the menu to swap active party members. Different characters excel in different situations.

tutorials.title: Item Crafting
tutorials.text: Combine materials to create potions and other items at crafting stations. Recipes unlock as you progress.

tutorials.title: Tower of Ascension
tutorials.text: The Tower contains powerful foes every 10 floors. Defeating them unlocks progression and valuable rewards.

tutorials.title: The World Break
tutorials.text: The world has changed! New areas are accessible, enemies may be stronger, and the story has advanced. Be prepared!
